name: Jinan-gun AI Data Center attraction drive
developer: Jinan-gun Council (attraction push; no operator named)
notes: Jinan-gun Council issued a statement urging relocation of the semiconductor national industrial park to Saemangeum RE100 park and attracting an AI data center to Jinan-gun. This is an official county-council resolution/push only; no signed investment agreement, developer, site, or capacity exists yet, so treated as announced intent.

name: KDT IDC Namwon Center
notes: KDT IDC's official data-center page lists Namwon Center as an upcoming GPU Dedicated Center with 2028 H1 RFS; no MW capacity disclosed. No other Namwon datacenter activity found in method searches.

name: Wanju AI Data Center (Techno Valley Industrial Complex)
developer: Techno Green with LG Electronics and KEPCO KDN
notes: MOU signed 2026-02-26 at Wanju County office for the first large AI data center in Jeonbuk, in Wanju Techno Valley Industrial Complex Phase 1. KRW 280bn investment; KEPCO KDN reports first-stage 20MW facility supply / 12MW IT load expandable to 40MW. Press reports construction timing at 2028-2029 (some reports say groundbreaking 2029), so status kept planned.

name: North Jeolla Province Data Center Project (ALG/Turnkey Capital)
developer: Aedan Looking Glass for Turnkey Capital Inc.
notes: DCD reports ALG signed a purchase and sale agreement for a 200MW Wanju County data center and was conducting due diligence, hoping to break ground in the following months. No permit/construction evidence found in this round.

name: Korea Health and Medical Data Center
developer: Jin International Co., Ltd. (with Damyang County)
notes: Damyang County signed an investment agreement (MOU) with Jin International on 2023-11-09 for a KRW 741.4bn 'Korea Health & Medical Data Center' at San 41-3, Samman-ri, Damyang-eup (55,642 sqm). Described as health, medical, telecom and finance data integration; no public MW capacity and no construction evidence found.

name: Gangjin Beneforce AI Data Center (Seongjeon-myeon)
developer: Benefos consortium with Daewoo E&C, KT, Top Solar, KG Engineering, IPA, Eugene Investment & Securities, Seed Investment Asset Management
notes: Jeonnam-do, Gangjin County, Jangseong County and 11 public/private bodies (incl. Benefos, Daewoo E&C, KT) signed an MOU 2026-01-16 for a KRW 3.3 trillion, 300MW-class AI data center at Wolhari, Seongjeon-myeon, Gangjin (about 87,000 pyeong / 287,000 sqm). Operations targeted 2029; permitting in progress per later coverage.

name: SDN Gangjin Industrial Complex AI Data Center
developer: SDN with Gangjin County and Huawei advisory/tenant support
notes: SDN announced a first-phase roughly 120MW AI data center using its Gangjin Industrial Complex land and power infrastructure, with UPS and liquid-cooling supply ambitions; treated as separate from the Seongjeon-myeon Beneforce project.

name: Jeonnam Goheung Smart Farm Innovation Valley Big Data Center
developer: Goheung-gun Smart Farm Office; operated with Sunchon National University
notes: Specialized agricultural big-data center inside the Smart Farm Innovation Valley support center collecting/analyzing crop-growth data; an operational sector-specific data center, not a hyperscale/colo facility. No other Goheung datacenter activity found.

name: Jeonnam/Gwangyang Cloud Data Center at Hwanggeum Industrial Complex
developer: Jeonnam Cloud Data Center Co.; KT; Microsoft Korea; Gwangyang GI; Korea Oracle / Mastern Investment Operation
notes: Cloud data center in Gwangyang Hwanggeum Industrial Complex (about 7,019 sqm site) under a 7-body business agreement (Jeonnam Cloud DC, KT, MS Korea, KEPCO Gwangju-Jeonnam HQ, etc.). MK reports 40MW-class hyperscale build; later local reporting describes a two-phase program to 2032 with total KRW 750bn and two 20MW-class centers, plus a Nov 2023 KRW 700bn Korea Oracle/Mastern investment agreement with KT, POSCO E&C/ICT, LS Electric. July groundbreaking was targeted but no completion confirmation found, so status kept planned.

name: National AI Computing Center at Solaseado Data Center Park
developer: Samsung SDS-led consortium / KOACC; Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT); Naver Cloud participation
notes: MSIT held the groundbreaking ceremony on 2026-08-03 at the Solaseado Data Center Park, Sanimyeon, Haenam-gun (about 48,000 sqm, 2-story), entering construction. Target completion 2028 with ~15,000 advanced AI semiconductors; local reports cite 40MW. Official government (gonggam.korea.kr) confirms construction start.

name: Solaseado RE100 Data Center Park / 1GW campus
developer: Jeollanam-do; Haenam County; Bosung Group / Seonamhaean Enterprise City Development; TGK / Diode Ventures
notes: Solaseado Data Center Park is a ~1.6 million sqm RE100 industrial site inside the Solaseado enterprise city in Haenam-gun Sanimyeon; designated a renewable-energy special district in June 2024. Campus-level plan phases to ~1GW via 25 x 40MW buildings; the National AI Computing Center (separate entry) is the first anchored project. Treated as campus-level planned capacity.

name: TGK / Bosung Solaseado RE100 Data Center Cluster phase
developer: Bosung Group; TGK; Diode Ventures; EIP Asset Management
notes: Initial Solaseado phase announced through a $2bn investment agreement: five 40MW RE100 data center buildings, total 200MW, at Solaseado in Haenam (Korean-US JV TGK). Related sources describe later expansion to the wider 1GW park.

name: Samsung Haenam Solaseado AI Data Center expansion plan
notes: Seoul Economic Daily reported Samsung's public plan to invest KRW 17 trillion at Haenam Solaseado for a 210MW AI data center targeting first operation in 2028, scaling beyond the 40MW government-backed National AI Computing Center. Announced/plan stage; capacity in Korean source written as MV but context indicates MW.

name: Hampyeong Wolya Global Data Center Cluster
notes: Hampyeong County and Jeollanam-do agreed to pursue a data-center concentration district; 2025 reporting cites attracting five 40MW operators, and 2023 semiconductor-special-zone reporting described a 20 x 40MW / 800MW target at Wolya General Industrial Complex. No named operator or permit found, so planned.

name: Jangseong Pine Data Center (Nam-myeon Advanced 3 District)
developer: Fine/Pine DCPFV; CJ OliveNetworks; Daewoo Engineering & Construction; Pine & Partners Asset Management; Hyundai Motor Securities
notes: Groundbreaking held 2025-12-15; first case of the government's data-center decentralization (Suwon-gwon dispersion) policy. Total project cost KRW 395.9bn; phase 1 is 26MW, with staged expansion to 60MW planned; target operation in H1 2028.

name: Daewoo/KT/Benefos Jangseong AI Data Center
developer: Benefos (Jangseong DC); Daewoo E&C; KT; Top Solar; Jeollanam-do; Jangseong County
notes: MOU signed 2026-01-16 (with Gangjin) for a KRW 2.2 trillion, 200MW phase-1 AI data center in Jangseong on a 57,967 sqm site; Benefos Jangseong DC named as executor. Later Sedaily English report said permitting underway with groundbreaking targeted for the following year.

name: AI Fabrik Jangseong AI Data Center (first stage)
developer: AI Fabrik (US AI infrastructure firm) with Aipasade; Jeonnam-Gwangju Integrated Special City and Jangseong County
notes: MOU signed 2026-08-03 by Jeonnam-Gwangju Integrated Special City, Jangseong County, US AI infra company AI Fabrik and Aipasade to formally start a 20MW AI data center - described as the first implementation stage of the Jan-2026 Jangseong AI DC program, with staged expansion planned. May overlap with the Beneforce Jangseong project campus; kept separate pending site confirmation.
